citation: Lichtman laboratory, Harvard University & Connectomics at Google. H01 release 20210601, proofread_104, segment 1072605926.

skeleton_seed.selection: largest source skeleton radius; neighborhood candidate, not new soma annotation

selection.detail_seed: Rightmost target-segment voxel on the target row and section at the 64 nm source pyramid level; approximate boundary candidate, not a synapse annotation

coordinate_scope: Same release-native nanometre frame. Image voxel cell [index*resolution,(index+1)*resolution); readout at cell centre. Skeleton source points retained without shifting; µm converted uniformly to nm. All voxel offsets are zero.
image_scope: Pillow-decoded grayscale samples from source JPEG pyramid chunks; source JPEG is lossy. Local gzip storage adds no further value change. Not raw detector counts or a quantitative staining measure.
mask_scope: Binary equality to uint64 source segment 1072605926, derived from proofread_104. Native image is 4x4x33 nm; its mask is 8x8x33 nm, displayed with nearest-neighbour cell footprints, not refined to 4 nm.

independent_validation.volume_decoder: TensorStore 0.1.85 independent of the image range decoder

volume_checks.scope: Repeated TensorStore read; consistency only, not an independent decoder check.

independent_validation.annotation_check: Spatial multi-record decoder and by-id single-record decoder agree exactly; uint64 retained as decimal strings; independent NumPy re-read of original by-id payloads.

ground_truth.scope: Site-pair IDs only; no validated mapping to the C3 annotation IDs used in this viewer.

limits: Fixed anatomical annotations, not activity or a propagation movie.
